title: Continuous Integration
author: Martin Fowler
why: The standard description of CI as a practice: mainline integration at least daily, self-testing builds, and fixing broken builds immediately.

title: The Practical Test Pyramid
author: Ham Vocke (on martinfowler.com)
why: A long, concrete walk through unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests and how many of each to write.

title: Continuous Delivery
author: Jez Humble and David Farley
why: The book that defined the deployment pipeline, build-once artifact promotion and the commit stage; the site summarises its principles.

title: SLSA: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts
author: OpenSSF
why: The framework for build provenance: how to prove a production artifact was built by your pipeline from a given commit.
